svg.title: Proposed ADBC hex badge isometric construction grid
svg.text: Proposed ADBC hex badge · isometric construction grid
Isometric projection, for the hex badge only. Every edge, the hexagon’s included, lands on one triangle grid.
Equilateral triangles: grid lines run three ways, vertical and ±30°, all
equally spaced. True isometric: view angle = arcsin(1/√3) ≈ 35.26°.
10 × 10 cells. Hole 8 × 8 (80%). Rim 1 cell all round.
Wall 1 cell tall, gap 2, so each layer sits 3 below the last.
Rim and wall are both 1 cell, so every band, black or white, is
Edges run only in the hexagon’s three directions: every angle is 60° or 120°.
Down the axis: rim, wall, space, 1:1:1, for 17 cells. The front
rim of the top layer lands where a 4th layer’s back rim would.
Gap (2) is twice the rim (1); each tab it leaves is exactly 1 cell.
Regular and centred on the ink, every side on a grid line: 3 lines clear
at the sides, 5 at top and bottom; the ring is 1 line thick, like the walls.
On the half grid, hanging ½ cell (half a wall) below the bottom layer. “ADBC”:
Barlow Bold, caps 1 cell tall (a wall’s height), from the left edge. URL: Roboto
Condensed Regular, x‑height ½ cell, so its baseline lands on a full grid line.
Mark 10 cells wide × 17 tall (10√3 : 17, nearly square). Ink 10 × 16.
